description: This file defines a specific exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedTagError' within the Twig template engine's Sandbox component, used when disallowed tags are encountered.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedTagError
classes.description: A custom exception class thrown when an unsupported or not allowed tag is used within Twig templates under sandbox restrictions. It extends 'SecurityError' and adds a 'tagName' property to specify which tag caused the error.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error with a message and the tag name that caused the exception.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of the tag associated with this error.
